# Arena 360 export file format (version 1)

<!-- Generated by `render_export_reference` in arena-store from the database migrations. Do not edit: run `ARENA_UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo test -p arena-store --test export_reference`. -->

An Arena 360 export (`.a360`) is a copy of one branch's whole database. You can open it with free tools, without Arena 360. This page is the reference for the file and every table in it. It describes schema version 84, with 74 tables.

## The file

| Part | Size | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Magic | 8 bytes | The text `A360EXP1`. Every export starts with it. |
| Header length | 4 bytes | A big-endian unsigned number: how many bytes the header takes. |
| Header | that many bytes | JSON, described below. |
| Body | the rest | The database, compressed with zstd. |

### Header fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `format_version` | number | The layout of this file. It is 1 for everything described here. |
| `branch_id` | text | The branch the export belongs to. |
| `branch_code` | text | The branch's short code, the start of the file name. |
| `epoch` | text | The epoch of the last change in the copy; empty when the copy holds none. |
| `last_seq` | number | The sequence number of that last change. Together with `epoch` it says what point in time the file stands for. |
| `schema_version` | number | The newest database migration the copy has. |
| `exported_at` | number | When the export was made, in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `sha256` | text | The SHA-256 of the body exactly as stored, in lower-case hex. It lets you check the file without decompressing it. |

## Opening an export without Arena 360

1. Read the first 12 bytes. Bytes 8 to 11 are the header length `N`.
2. The header is the next `N` bytes. The body starts right after it.
3. Save the body to a file and decompress it with the stock `zstd` tool: `zstd -d body.zst -o branch.db`.
4. Open `branch.db` with any SQLite tool, for example `sqlite3 branch.db .tables`.

On Linux or macOS, `tail -c +<N+13> file.a360 > body.zst` cuts the body out. The reports exported beside a database in an "Export everything" folder are plain CSV files that open in any spreadsheet.

## Conventions

- **Money** is stored in minor units: whole paise for INR, never a decimal. A column ending in `_minor` holds one. Divide by 100 for rupees (the branch's currency exponent says how many places). The CSV reports show major units with the currency code.
- **Times** are whole milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. Business days (`YYYY-MM-DD`) are in the branch's time zone, which the `branch` and settings tables name.
- **Rates** (tax, shares) are basis points: 100 is 1%.
- **Yes/no** columns hold 0 or 1.
- **Ids** are text (ULIDs) unless a column says otherwise.
- **Ciphertext**: a player's personal data (name, phone, email, date of birth, notes) is stored encrypted, with a key of its own per player. Those columns are marked *ciphertext* below. The keys are wrapped by a branch key that is not in the file, so the file alone cannot read them, and an erased player's data can never be read again.
- `changes` is the gap-free log of every change. `rev` columns count how often a row changed.

## What an export leaves out or clears

- The licence cache is emptied.
- Device tokens (`devices.token_hash`) and kitchen display tokens (`kitchen_displays.token_hash`) are emptied.
- The reference cache (game catalogue and media) and the keystore secrets are not in the database, so they are not in the file.

## Tables

74 tables, in name order.

### `ad_impressions`

One row for each advert shown on a screen, kept only as a count; it holds nothing that identifies a device, advert or advertiser.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Running number of the impression; later impressions have higher numbers. |
| `slot` | text |  | Where the advert was shown: banner or interstitial. |
| `at` | integer |  | When the advert was shown. |

### `ad_request_cursor`

A single row that remembers how far advert requests have been reported to the cloud.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Always 1; the table has only one row. |
| `through_id` | integer |  | The highest advert request number the cloud has acknowledged. |

### `ad_requests`

One row for each time a screen asked for an advert, kept only as a count with nothing that identifies a device or advertiser.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Running number of the request; later requests have higher numbers. |
| `slot` | text |  | Where the advert was requested for: banner or interstitial. |
| `at` | integer |  | When the advert was requested. |

### `ad_upload_cursor`

A single row that remembers how far advert impressions have been reported to the cloud.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Always 1; the table has only one row. |
| `through_id` | integer |  | The highest advert impression number the cloud has acknowledged. |

### `alerts`

Alerts raised by the Hub that staff must acknowledge, such as time up, low stock or a missing controller.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | primary | Unique id of the alert. |
| `kind` | text |  | What the alert is about: fixture (test only), time_up, controller_missing, printer_offline, stock_expiring, stock_low, login_lockout, check_pc, call_staff, kiosk_order, order_ready or backup_disk. |
| `device_id` | text, may be empty | → `devices.device_id` | The row of `devices.device_id` this row belongs to. |
| `raised_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `acked_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `acked_by` | text, may be empty |  | Id of the staff member who acknowledged the alert; empty while it is still open. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `product_id` | text, may be empty | → `products.product_id` | The row of `products.product_id` this row belongs to. |
| `qty` | integer, may be empty |  | For a low-stock alert, the quantity on hand when the alert was raised; empty for other alerts. |
| `threshold` | integer, may be empty |  | For a low-stock alert, the low-stock level that was crossed; empty for other alerts. |
| `ticket_id` | text, may be empty |  | For an order-ready alert at the counter, the id of the kitchen ticket it is about; empty for other alerts. |

### `applied_commands`

Commands sent from the owner's app that the Hub has applied or rejected, so none is applied twice.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command_id` | integer | primary | Running number of the command in the order the Hub received it. |
| `idempotency_key` | text |  | A unique key that stops the same command being applied twice. |
| `kind` | text |  | The type of command, for example a change to a setting. |
| `status` | text |  | Whether the Hub applied the command or rejected it: applied or rejected. |
| `applied_seq` | integer, may be empty |  | The number of the audit-log entry the command produced; empty if it was rejected. |
| `error` | text, may be empty |  | Why the command was rejected; empty if it was applied. |
| `applied_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `reported_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `applied_intents`

A record of every request the Hub has finished handling, so a repeated request gets the same answer instead of being done twice. Records older than 30 days are removed.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idempotency_key` | text | primary | A unique key sent with the request that stops it being applied twice. |
| `intent_id` | text |  | Unique id of the request. |
| `intent_kind` | text |  | The type of request, for example starting a session or settling a bill. |
| `fingerprint` | text |  | A fingerprint of the request contents, used to detect a key being reused for a different request. |
| `outcome` | blob |  | The stored result of the request in a compact binary form, returned again if the request is repeated. |
| `applied_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `backup_state`

A single row that tracks whether the player encryption keys have been backed up.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Always 1; the table has only one row. |
| `keys_version` | integer |  | A counter that goes up every time a player encryption key is added, changed or removed. |
| `keys_backed_up_version` | integer |  | The value of the key counter at the last successful key backup. |
| `keys_backed_up_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `keys_error` | text, may be empty |  | A short code for why the last key backup failed; it never contains player data. |
| `keys_error_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `kek_escrowed_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `branch`

The branch (cafe location) this Hub runs: its name, code, currency and time settings.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branch_id` | text | primary | Unique id of the branch. |
| `name` | text |  | The branch's name as shown to staff and on receipts. |
| `branch_code` | text |  | The short code of the branch, used as the first part of invoice numbers. |
| `currency` | text |  | The currency code the branch trades in, for example INR. |
| `tz` | text |  | The branch's time zone name, for example Asia/Kolkata; it decides where each business day starts and ends. |
| `day_start_min` | integer |  | When the business day starts, in minutes after midnight (0 to 1439). |
| `fy_start_month` | integer |  | The month the financial year starts, 1 for January to 12 for December. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `bundle_components`

The products that make up each bundle product.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_id` | text | primary, → `products.product_id` | The row of `products.product_id` this row belongs to. |
| `component_id` | text | primary, → `products.product_id` | The row of `products.product_id` this row belongs to. |
| `qty` | integer |  | How many of the component product go into one bundle. |

### `cash_events`

Every movement of cash against a shift: sales, refunds, float, deposits and expenses. Rows are never edited; an undo adds a reversing row.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | primary | Unique id of the cash event. |
| `shift_id` | text | → `shifts.id` | The row of `shifts.id` this row belongs to. |
| `kind` | text |  | The type of event: sale, sale_reverted, refund, float_in, deposit, expense or drawer_open. |
| `amount_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `staff_id` | text |  | Id of the staff member who recorded the event. |
| `order_id` | text, may be empty |  | The bill the cash event belongs to, if any. |
| `reverses` | text, may be empty | → `cash_events.id` | The row of `cash_events.id` this row belongs to. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `reference` | text, may be empty |  | A reference typed in by staff, such as a bank deposit slip number. |
| `category` | text, may be empty |  | For an expense, what it was for: supplies, utilities, repairs, food_stock or other. |
| `paid_from` | text, may be empty |  | For an expense, who paid it: drawer (cash from the till) or owner (the owner paid from their own pocket). |
| `spent_minor` | integer, may be empty |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `note` | text, may be empty |  | Free text note typed in by staff. |
| `receipt_photo` | text, may be empty |  | A small photo of the receipt for an expense, stored as a JPEG data link of at most 200 KB. |

### `changes`

The audit log. Every change to the branch data is recorded here once, in order, and rows are never edited or deleted.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epoch` | text | primary | The era of the Hub that wrote the change; a new epoch starts when a different Hub takes over as the writer. Together with seq it fixes the change's place in the log. |
| `seq` | integer | primary | The change's number within its epoch, counted without gaps. |
| `tbl` | text |  | The name of the table the change was made to. |
| `row_id` | text |  | The id of the row that was changed. |
| `op` | text |  | What was done to the row: insert, update or delete. |
| `row` | blob |  | The contents of the row after the change, in a compact binary form. |
| `intent_id` | text |  | Unique id of the request that caused the change. |
| `intent_kind` | text |  | The type of request that caused the change, for example session.start. |
| `actor_kind` | text |  | Who made the change: staff, owner, admin, system or device. |
| `actor_id` | text |  | Id of the person or device that made the change. |
| `elevated_by_kind` | text, may be empty |  | How a manager approved the change when approval was needed: pin or mfa; empty if none. |
| `elevated_by_id` | text, may be empty |  | Id of the manager who approved the change; empty if none. |
| `elevated_by_mode` | text, may be empty |  | Where the approval was checked: hub (the Hub itself) or cached_verifier (a copy kept on the device while offline); empty if none. |
| `elevated_by_verifier_version` | integer, may be empty |  | The version of the manager credential list the approval was checked against; empty if none. |
| `at` | integer |  | When the change was made. |
| `business_day` | text, may be empty |  | The business day the change was made on; empty for the oldest entries. |
| `fy` | text, may be empty |  | The financial year the change was made in; empty for the oldest entries. |
| `reason` | text, may be empty |  | The reason code given for the change when the request required one; empty otherwise. |

### `consents`

A history of each player's consent choices for messages. Rows are never edited, a new row records a new choice.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `consent_id` | text | primary | Unique id of the consent record. |
| `player_id` | text | → `players.player_id` | The row of `players.player_id` this row belongs to. |
| `purpose` | text |  | What the consent covers: transactional (receipts and service messages) or marketing. |
| `policy_version` | text |  | The version of the privacy policy the player agreed to or withdrew from. |
| `granted` | integer |  | 1 if consent was given, 0 if it was withdrawn. |
| `at` | integer |  | When the player gave or withdrew consent. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; consent rows are not edited, so this stays at its first value. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |

| `target_kind` | text | primary | What kind of item the coupon is limited to: group, plan or product. |
| `target_id` | text | primary | The id of the device group, plan or product. |

Discount coupons that staff can apply when settling a bill.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coupon_id` | text | primary | Unique id of the coupon. |
| `code` | text |  | The code staff type in, always in capital letters and unique in the branch. |
| `percent_bp` | integer, may be empty |  | A rate in basis points (100 = 1%). |
| `amount_minor` | integer, may be empty |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |

| `valid_to` | text, may be empty |  | Last business day (YYYY-MM-DD) the coupon can be used; empty means no end date. |
| `usage_limit` | integer, may be empty |  | The most times the coupon can be used; empty means unlimited. |
| `used` | integer |  | How many bills have used the coupon so far. |
| `min_bill_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `active` | integer |  | 1 if the item is switched on and can be used, 0 if it has been switched off. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

How much each player owes on credit (pay later) and the rules for it.

| `outstanding_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |

| `credit_paused` | integer |  | 1 if new credit for the player is paused, 0 if credit can be given. |

| `branch_id` | text | → `branch.branch_id` | The row of `branch.branch_id` this row belongs to. |
| `device_id` | text | → `devices.device_id` | The row of `devices.device_id` this row belongs to. |
| `staff_id` | text |  | Id of the manager who approved the exit. |
| `mode` | text |  | How the exit was approved: hub (PIN checked by the Hub), cached_verifier (PIN checked offline on the PC) or remote (unlocked from the Hub). |
| `started_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `relock_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `relocked_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `flagged` | integer |  | 1 if the exit needs a manager's attention, for example an offline PIN that was out of date; otherwise 0. |
| `flag_reason` | text, may be empty |  | Why the exit was flagged; empty if not flagged. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `stock_moves`

The stock ledger: every increase or decrease of a product's stock. Rows are never edited.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `move_id` | text | primary | Unique id of the stock movement. |
| `product_id` | text | → `products.product_id` | The row of `products.product_id` this row belongs to. |
| `reason` | text |  | Why stock moved: stock_in, stock_in_reverted, sale, sale_reverted, return, waste, waste_reverted, expired or count_adjust. |
| `delta` | integer |  | The change in quantity; negative when stock leaves. |
| `before_qty` | integer |  | The quantity in stock just before the movement. |
| `before_avg_cost_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `unit_cost_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `supplier` | text |  | The supplier's name for a stock-in; empty otherwise. |
| `lot_id` | text, may be empty |  | The batch that was received for a stock-in; empty otherwise. |
| `lots_used` | text |  | Which batches the stock was taken from, in a text format. |
| `staff_id` | text |  | Id of the staff member who made the movement. |
| `at` | integer |  | When the stock moved. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `waste_reason` | text, may be empty |  | For waste, why: spoiled, broken, free or cancelled_order. |
| `value_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `order_id` | text, may be empty |  | The bill the movement belongs to, if any. |
| `note` | text, may be empty |  | Free text note added by staff. |
| `elevated_by` | text, may be empty |  | Id of the manager who approved the movement, when approval was needed. |
| `placement_id` | text, may be empty |  | The id of the order placement that caused the movement, if any. |

### `trusted_clock`

A single row used to tell the true time from the cloud, even if the PC's clock is changed.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Always 1; the table has only one row. |
| `cloud_ms` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `mono_ms` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `wall_delta_ms` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `upload_cursor`

A single row that remembers how much of the audit log has been uploaded to the cloud.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | primary | Always 1; the table has only one row. |
| `epoch` | text |  | The epoch of the last change the cloud has stored. |
| `last_seq_uploaded` | integer |  | The number of the last audit-log change the cloud has stored. |
| `uploaded_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `first_uploaded_at` | integer, may be empty |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |

### `verifier_history`

A history of the manager credential lists used to approve actions while offline.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | primary | The version number of the list. |
| `valid_from` | integer |  | When this version came into effect. |
| `digest` | text |  | A fingerprint of the list, used to tell versions apart. |
| `staff_ids` | text |  | The ids of the managers the list covered, one per line; it holds no PINs or hashes. |

### `wallet_txns`

Every credit and debit of a player's wallet.

| Column | Type | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | primary | Unique id of the wallet entry. |
| `player_id` | text | → `players.player_id` | The row of `players.player_id` this row belongs to. |
| `delta_minor` | integer |  | An amount in minor currency units (paise for INR). |
| `reason` | text |  | Why the balance changed: topup, bill, credit, import, erase_refund or erase_forfeit. |
| `method` | text, may be empty |  | How the top-up was paid, for example cash or upi; empty for other entries. |
| `staff_id` | text |  | Id of the staff member who made the entry. |
| `order_id` | text, may be empty | → `orders.id` | The row of `orders.id` this row belongs to. |
| `business_day` | text |  | The business day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the branch time zone) the record belongs to. |
| `fy` | text |  | The financial year the record belongs to, used for invoice numbering and tax reports. |
| `rev` | integer |  | How many times the row has changed; the Hub uses it to refuse stale edits. |
| `created_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
| `updated_at` | integer |  | A time as milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. |
